role: Declares DeepDiveReportRenderer, a stateless value built per access by PDFReportGenerator.deepDive (PDFReportGenerator+DeepDiveForwarding.swift:16-18) that draws the clinical deep-dive pages (HRV, sleep, training, vitals) of the overnight/recovery PDF; it borrows only the generator config and page-break helper.
types: DeepDiveReportRenderer: struct — deep-dive page renderer holding a strong reference to its PDFReportGenerator; extended by DeepDiveReportRenderer+Pages.swift and +Body.swift
toplevel: Struct with one stored property `generator`; synthesized memberwise init used at PDFReportGenerator+DeepDiveForwarding.swift:17. A new renderer is constructed on every `deepDive` access (computed property), so each forwarded call builds a fresh value.

units.does: Computed property returning generator.config (PDFReportGenerator.Config) so the deep-dive drawing code reads margins, colours and fonts of the owning generator.

Forwards a page-break request to PDFReportGenerator.ensureSpace (which forwards to ReportSectionRenderer.ensureSpace): if `needed` does not fit below `y`, the generator starts a new page and increments pageNumber; returns the y to draw at.
